assumptions.choice: Use 1% of current total broker value per trade, rounded down to whole shares.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives 1% as its fixed-percentage example but does not define a different percentage or fractional-share policy.

assumptions.choice: Use closing prices for RSI, both SMAs, Bollinger Bands, entry conditions, and middle-line crossing.
assumptions.reason: The specification refers to price without selecting an OHLC field; close is the standard daily-bar interpretation.

assumptions.choice: Use the total volume of the last 20 candles and require it to be greater than 0.
assumptions.reason: N is exemplified as 20 and no numerical liquidity threshold is supplied; zero is the least additional threshold that preserves the stated volume filter.

assumptions.choice: Exit longs only on an upward close crossing of the Bollinger middle line and shorts only on a downward close crossing.
assumptions.reason: This applies the crossing direction consistent with mean reversion from the respective entry side.

assumptions.choice: Create stop-loss and take-profit orders after the entry fills, using the actual fill price for the 1.5-standard-deviation stop and the middle-band value captured when the entry was submitted for take-profit.
assumptions.reason: The stop is specified from the entry point, while the take-profit is specified at the middle-line level from the entry point.
